bullets.text: Cloud-Based Ransomware Threat - **Storm-0501** shifts focus to cloud tactics, exfiltrating data without traditional malware.
Market Leader in Security - **Microsoft Defender** achieves number one ranking in modern endpoint security for the third consecutive year.
Securing Autonomous Agents - **Microsoft** emphasizes the need for governance as autonomous agents proliferate in enterprises.
Azure Infrastructure Security - **Microsoft** enhances security from silicon to systems, prioritizing secure design in cloud architecture.
Open Source Evolution - **Microsoft** transforms into a leading open source contributor, impacting AI and cloud technologies.
Leader in Cloud-Native Platforms - **Microsoft** recognized as a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud-Native Application Platforms.
ClickFix Social Engineering - **Microsoft** warns of the rising ClickFix technique, tricking users into executing malicious commands.
